newsitem.title: FRANCE: Most French favour early retirement - poll.
newsitem.headline: Most French favour early retirement - poll.

text.p: Three out of five French people would like the retirement age lowered to 55 from 60 to help create new jobs, an opinion poll said on Tuesday.
The BVA survey said 61 percent of 788 people questioned wanted early retirement against 31 percent who believed it would only make it more difficult to finance pensions.
The highest proportion of those favouring early retiremnt were in the 25-34 age group. The lowest, predictably, was among pensioners aged over 65.

Unemployment stands at 12.7 percent. French truck drivers with 25 years' experience behind the wheel won the right to retire at 55 after a crippling 12-day strike last November, and some unions want the right extended to other workers.
